versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the translation-bwc skill to support bidirectional (EN-ZH/中文) translation of BWC product and API documentation.
- Enforces use of BWC-specific terminology from a central glossary and ensures consistent technical-writing style.
- Preserves code, identifiers, placeholders, and original structure in technical content.
- Provides a checklist for terminology accuracy and technical/language conventions in translated output.
- Applies only to BWC-related material; not for generic translation requests without BWC context.
